source.title: Spline conversion: Existing solutions and open problems

trace.notes: Normalized the input as a zbMATH bibliographic resolver URL with trailing identifier 727936.

Failure modes: network_or_dns_failure for local shell access to zbmath.org and api.zbmath.org, metadata_only for the zbMATH resolver context available through local shard metadata, and paywalled_or_restricted or metadata_only for candidate book and chapter landing pages. Local resolver metadata in outputs/shards/open-problems-shard-0.csv identified zbMATH identifier 727936 as the 1994 chapter Spline conversion: Existing solutions and open problems, but that metadata does not contain the technical problem statements.

Routledge book metadata for Curves and Surfaces confirmed the edited volume, publisher, year, page count, and table-of-contents entry Spline Conversion: Existing Solutions and Open Problems by T. Dokken and T. Lyche. Grafiati exposed the matching DOI candidate 10.1201/9781439863596-14 for a Curves and Surfaces chapter by T. Dokken and T. Lyche. These metadata sources were used only for source identity, title recovery, and bounded recovery, not for question extraction.

Ran exact-work recovery attempts using the zbMATH identifier 727936, the exact title Spline conversion: Existing solutions and open problems, the authors Dokken and Lyche, the book ISBNs 9781568810393 and 9781439863596, and the DOI candidate 10.1201/9781439863596-14. Inspected candidate pages from Routledge, Taylor/DOI resolution, Perlego, Academia.edu, Grafiati, and exact-title PDF searches. Routledge and Perlego exposed only book metadata, table of contents, preview, or subscription access; Academia.edu listed the work without a readable linked paper body; Grafiati linked only to the DOI; exact-title PDF searches returned citations in other papers, preview/table-of-contents PDFs, or different works. No readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source containing the chapter's open-problem statements was recovered within the bounded pass.

No candidates were mapped, extracted, rewritten, deduplicated, or accepted because no readable PDF or HTML full-text artifact could be confirmed and accessed as the same exact zbMATH source. The workflow forbids extracting questions from resolver metadata, abstracts, citation pages, tables of contents, preview-only pages, search snippets, paywalled pages, or different works.
Saved final JSON to outputs/parse-paper/727936.json and updated outputs/latest.json.
